meta.title: Multi-Currency Bidding: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role on an Enterprise tenant
Locate and attempt Multi-Currency Bidding, including vendor-own-currency bidding with rates locked at publish, and observe whether Procol refuses or omits it
Repeat the same action as a Buyer and compare that it is available
Verify or change the tenant's Enterprise plan and record whether RBAC intentionally grants the feature to additional roles
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role on an Enterprise tenant; Locate and attempt Multi-Currency Bidding, including vendor-own-currency bidding with rates locked at publish, and observe whether Procol refuses or omits it; Repeat the same action as a Buyer and compare that it is available; Verify or change the tenant's Enterprise plan and record whether RBAC intentionally grants the feature to additional roles

args.need: sign in as a non-Buyer and then as a Buyer on the Enterprise tenant, attempt Multi-Currency Bidding with vendor-own-currency bids and rates locked at publish, and record whether the feature is refused or absent for the non-Buyer but available to the Buyer

steps.note: No catalog step can switch to the required personas or observe the Multi-Currency Bidding control and its role-based outcome.
Confirm the session remains free of an application error after the tester completes the role comparison.
